summary: Bug fix verification for 4 reported navigation/UI issues. 3 out of 4 fixes VERIFIED WORKING. Found 1 NEW critical bug - Orange HealthPlus card navigates to /nutricare which has NO route defined.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Orange HealthPlus card in OrangeMedcare.js navigates to /nutricare (line 46), but NO /nutricare route exists in App.js. Results in showing intro screen instead of actual content.
integration_issues.suggested_fix: Either add /nutricare route in App.js pointing to a NutriCare component, OR change the navigate path in OrangeMedcare.js to an existing route

action_items: CRITICAL: Add /nutricare route in App.js OR change Orange HealthPlus card destination in OrangeMedcare.js from '/nutricare' to valid route
critical_code_review_comments: OrangeMedcare.js line 46: navigate('/nutricare') - this route does not exist in App.js routes
Console shows 'No routes matched location /nutricare' when clicking Orange HealthPlus card

context_for_next_testing_agent: 4 bugs were reported as fixed. However, Orange HealthPlus CARD on /orange page navigates to /nutricare which has NO ROUTE - this is a new critical bug.
